full_name: Kaia Stern | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Kaia Stern is the cofounder and director of the Prison Studies Project at Harvard University and a visiting faculty member at the Harvard Graduate School of Education, where she leads the Transformative Justice Program. Her work focuses on ethics, justice, and education in prison.
